name: Mrk 42

reference_note: The comparison star closest in brightness to the target serves as the statistical reference.
validation_note: Comparison candidates were selected for brightness and isolation, checked against APASS DR9 and Gaia DR3, and known/suspected variables were excluded using VSX.
paper_title: The 2MIG isolated AGNs. 3. Optical–IR variability and dust reverberation in the NLSy1 galaxies Mrk 42 and Mrk 493

name: IC 1495
observing_summary: Two consecutive IAC80/CAMELOT2 sequences: 26 × 250 s in R on 2025 October 13 and 35 × 300 s in V on 2025 October 14.
reference_note: Three numbered APASS DR9 field stars were used for differential photometry. APASS V magnitudes are used directly; R is estimated from APASS Sloan r′ and i′ using the Lupton transformation.
validation_note: The sequence contains APASS V/g′/r′/i′ photometry and provisional R estimates from the Lupton transformation. Missing or zero catalogue uncertainties are displayed as unavailable.
photometry_system_note: V, g′, r′ and i′ are APASS DR9 catalogue values. The R magnitudes are estimates transformed from Sloan r′ and i′ using the Lupton relation; they are not direct APASS R measurements. The independently transformed V values from g′ and r′ differ from APASS V by only 0.028–0.038 mag for the three stars.
extra_note: The supplied static chart identifies stars 1–3 and lists the adopted APASS V magnitudes.
